Avalanche.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the target has already dealt damage to the user with a move in the same turn.

Axe Kick.text: Has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails the user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP.
Axe Kick.serebii: Has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails the user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP.
Axe Kick.pokebase: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

Baby-Doll Eyes.text: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Baby-Doll Eyes.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.

Barb Barrage.serebii: Has a 50% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.
Barb Barrage.pokebase: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

Baton Pass.serebii: The user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon. If the user had any stat changes a substitute or other such effects they will be passed on to the Pokémon switching in.

Beak Blast.text: If the user is hit by a contact move before it uses this move the attacker will be burned.
Beak Blast.serebii: If the user is hit by a contact move before it uses this move the attacker will be burned.
Beak Blast.pokebase: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.

Beat Up.serebii: The target is attacked as many times as the number of Pokémon in the user's party. Pokémon that have fainted or have a status condition are not counted. This move's power is calculated based on the Attack stats of the party Pokémon.
Beat Up.pokebase: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

Belch.text: This move fails unless the user has eaten a Berry during the battle.
Belch.serebii: This move fails unless the user has eaten a Berry during the battle.
Belch.pokebase: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

Belly Drum.text: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to boost its Attack stat to its sixth stage. This move fails if the user doesn't have enough remaining HP.
Belly Drum.serebii: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to boost its Attack stat to its sixth stage. This move fails if the user doesn't have enough remaining HP.
Belly Drum.pokebase: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

Bind.pokebase: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

Bite.text: Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.
Bite.serebii: Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

Bitter Blade.serebii: The user's HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.

Bitter Malice.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.

Blizzard.serebii: Has a 10% chance of freezing targets. This move never misses in snow.
Blizzard.pokebase: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

Block.text: Gives the target the Can't Escape status.
Block.serebii: Gives the target the Can't Escape status.
Block.pokebase: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.

Body Press.serebii: The damage dealt by this move is calculated using the user's Defense stat instead of its Attack stat.
Body Press.pokebase: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

Body Slam.serebii: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. If the target has the Minimized status this move's power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

Bone Rush.text: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Bone Rush.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.

Boomburst.pokebase: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

Brave Bird.serebii: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

Breaking Swipe.serebii: Lowers targets' Attack stats by 1 stage.

Whirlpool.text: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

Wide Guard.serebii: During the turn this move is used the user protects its side from moves that target all allies.

Analytic.serebii: Attack power increases by 30% if the Pokémon is the last Pokémon to attack this turn
Analytic.pokebase: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

Anger Point.serebii: Increases Attack to maximum level upon taking a critical hit.
Anger Point.pokebase: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

Anticipation.text: Warns when the foe knows 1-hit KO or super-effective moves.
Anticipation.serebii: Warns when the foe knows 1-hit KO or super-effective moves.

Armor Tail.serebii: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
Armor Tail.pokebase: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

Aroma Veil.serebii: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.

Aura Guard.serebii: Reduces the amount of damage received by moves that make physical contact by 50%

Blaze.serebii: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Fire-type moves is increased by 50%.

Bulletproof.serebii: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

Cheek Pouch.serebii: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

Chlorophyll.text: When sunny, the Pokémon’s Speed doubles.
Chlorophyll.serebii: When sunny, the Pokémon’s Speed doubles.
Chlorophyll.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

Clear Body.serebii: Opponents’ moves which lower this Pokémon’s stats have no effect. However this Pokémon may lower its own stats with its own moves.

Cloud Nine.serebii: All weather effects are negated while the Pokémon is on the field.

Competitive.serebii: Raises Sp. Atk stat by two stages whenever a stat is lowered

Corrosion.serebii: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

Curious Medicine.text: When the Pokémon is brought into battle, any stat alterations of allies are removed
Curious Medicine.serebii: When the Pokémon is brought into battle, any stat alterations of allies are removed

Cursed Body.text: When a move hits the Pokémon, that move has a 30% chance of getting disabled
Cursed Body.serebii: When a move hits the Pokémon, that move has a 30% chance of getting disabled
Cursed Body.pokebase: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

Cute Charm.serebii: The opponent has a 30% chance of being induced with Attract when using an attack, that requires physical contact, against this Pokémon.

Damp.text: Explosion, Selfdestruct, Mind Blown & Misty Explosion will not work while the Pokémon is on the field.

Defiant.serebii: Attack is raised by two stages when the Pokémon has its stats lowered. Doesn't work on self inflicted stat drops or drops from allies
Defiant.pokebase: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

Dragonize.serebii: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

Electric Surge.serebii: Activates Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

Sand Veil.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms.

Sap Sipper.text: Attack is raised by one stage when the Pokémon is hit by a Grass-type move. User receives no damage from Grass-type attacks.
Sap Sipper.serebii: Attack is raised by one stage when the Pokémon is hit by a Grass-type move. User receives no damage from Grass-type attacks.
Sap Sipper.pokebase: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.

Scrappy.text: Allows the Pokémon to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves. Blocks Intimidate
Scrappy.serebii: Allows the Pokémon to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves. Blocks Intimidate
Scrappy.pokebase: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

Screen Cleaner.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
Screen Cleaner.serebii: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
Screen Cleaner.pokebase: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

Seed Sower.text: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves.
Seed Sower.serebii: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
Seed Sower.pokebase: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves.

Shadow Tag.text: The opponent cannot run nor switch while this Pokémon is in play. The opponent may still switch by using Baton Pass, U-turn or Volt Switch, if it is holding a Shed Shell or is a Ghost-type.
Shadow Tag.serebii: The opponent cannot run nor switch while this Pokémon is in play. The opponent may still switch by using Baton Pass, U-turn or Volt Switch, if it is holding a Shed Shell or is a Ghost-type.
Shadow Tag.pokebase: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

Sharpness.text: Increases the power of Slicing moves used by this Pokémon by 50%
Sharpness.serebii: Increases the power of Slicing moves used by this Pokémon by 50%

Shed Skin.text: Every turn, it has a 1 in 3 chance of healing from a status condition (BURN, PARALYZE, SLEEP, POISON, FREEZE).
Shed Skin.serebii: Every turn, it has a 1 in 3 chance of healing from a status condition (BURN, PARALYZE, SLEEP, POISON, FREEZE).
Shed Skin.pokebase: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

Sheer Force.text: Moves with a secondary effect are increased in power by 30% but lose their secondary effect
Sheer Force.serebii: Moves with a secondary effect are increased in power by 30% but lose their secondary effect
Sheer Force.pokebase: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

Shell Armor.pokebase: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

Shield Dust.text: Damaging moves used by the opponent will not have an additional effect.
Shield Dust.serebii: Damaging moves used by the opponent will not have an additional effect.
Shield Dust.pokebase: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

Skill Link.text: Moves that attack 2-5 times always hit 5 times.
Skill Link.serebii: Moves that attack 2-5 times always hit 5 times.
Skill Link.pokebase: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

Slush Rush.text: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed when Snow is in effect
Slush Rush.serebii: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed when Snow is in effect
Slush Rush.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

Sniper.text: Power of critical-hit moves is increased to 225% rather than 150%.
Sniper.serebii: Power of critical-hit moves is increased to 225% rather than 150%.
Sniper.pokebase: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

Snow Cloak.text: Raises the Pokémon’s evasion during a Snowstorm by one level.
Snow Cloak.serebii: Raises the Pokémon’s evasion during a Snowstorm by one level.
Snow Cloak.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

Snow Warning.text: Snowstorm blows when the Pokémon enters battle. As of X & Y, this lasts 5 turns.
Snow Warning.serebii: Snowstorm blows when the Pokémon enters battle. As of X & Y, this lasts 5 turns.

Solar Power.text: During sunshine, the Pokémon’s Special Attack raises to 1.5 times but HP decreases by 1/8th the maximum HP every turn.
Solar Power.serebii: During sunshine, the Pokémon’s Special Attack raises to 1.5 times but HP decreases by 1/8th the maximum HP every turn.
Solar Power.pokebase: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

Solid Rock.text: Damage by super-effective moves is reduced by 25%.
Solid Rock.serebii: Damage by super-effective moves is reduced by 25%.
Solid Rock.pokebase: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

Soundproof.text: Unaffected by sound moves. If this Pokémon switches out with Baton Pass, Perish Song against the switched out will not be nullified.
Soundproof.serebii: Unaffected by sound moves. If this Pokémon switches out with Baton Pass, Perish Song against the switched out will not be nullified.
Soundproof.pokebase: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

Speed Boost.text: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat by 1 stage at the end of every turn. The Speed stat will not be boosted on the turn that the Pokémon switches into battle.
Speed Boost.serebii: Speed increases by one stage at the end of each turn.
Speed Boost.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat by 1 stage at the end of every turn. The Speed stat will not be boosted on the turn that the Pokémon switches into battle.

Spicy Spray.text: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
Spicy Spray.serebii: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
Spicy Spray.pokebase: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

Stakeout.text: Doubles the damage dealt to the target's replacement if the target switches out.
Stakeout.serebii: Doubles the damage dealt to the target's replacement if the target switches out.
Stakeout.pokebase: Doubles the power of the Pokémon's moves when it attacks targets that have just switched into battle.

Stall.pokebase: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.

Stalwart.text: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
Stalwart.serebii: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
Stalwart.pokebase: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

Stamina.text: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.
Stamina.serebii: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.
Stamina.pokebase: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

Stance Change.text: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.
Stance Change.serebii: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.
Stance Change.pokebase: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

Static.text: The opponent has a 30% chance of being induced with PARALYZE when using an attack, that requires physical contact, against this Pokémon.
Static.serebii: The opponent has a 30% chance of being induced with PARALYZE when using an attack, that requires physical contact, against this Pokémon.
Static.pokebase: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

Steadfast.text: Speed raises by one level every time the Pokémon flinches.
Steadfast.serebii: Speed raises by one level every time the Pokémon flinches.
Steadfast.pokebase: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

Steely Spirit.text: Increases the power of Steel-type moves used by the user or any Ally Pokémon by 50%
Steely Spirit.serebii: Increases the power of Steel-type moves used by the user or any Ally Pokémon by 50%
Steely Spirit.pokebase: Boosts the power of the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies by 50%.

Stench.text: If the Pokémon uses a move that deals damage on the opponent, there is a chance the opponent flinches
Stench.serebii: If the Pokémon uses a move that deals damage on the opponent, there is a chance the opponent flinches
Stench.pokebase: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

Sticky Hold.text: This Pokémon’s item cannot be taken.
Sticky Hold.serebii: This Pokémon’s item cannot be taken.
Sticky Hold.pokebase: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

Strong Jaw.text: Increases the power of biting moves by 50%
Strong Jaw.serebii: Increases the power of biting moves by 50%
Strong Jaw.pokebase: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

Sturdy.text: The Pokémon will remain with 1 HP if it was going to be knocked out by a move when at full Hit Points, and it is immune to One Hit KO moves.
Sturdy.serebii: The Pokémon will remain with 1 HP if it was going to be knocked out by a move when at full Hit Points, and it is immune to One Hit KO moves.
Sturdy.pokebase: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

Suction Cups.text: Negates moves that force switching out.
Suction Cups.serebii: Negates moves that force switching out.
Suction Cups.pokebase: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

Super Luck.text: Raises the critical-hit ratio of moves by one level.
Super Luck.serebii: Raises the critical-hit ratio of moves by one level.
Super Luck.pokebase: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

Supersweet Syrup.text: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
Supersweet Syrup.serebii: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
Supersweet Syrup.pokebase: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

Supreme Overlord.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted by 10% for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
Supreme Overlord.serebii: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted by 10% for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
Supreme Overlord.pokebase: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

Surge Surfer.text: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
Surge Surfer.serebii: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
Surge Surfer.pokebase: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

Swarm.text: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Bug-type moves is increased by 50%.
Swarm.serebii: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Bug-type moves is increased by 50%.
Swarm.pokebase: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

Sweet Veil.text: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.
Sweet Veil.serebii: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.
Sweet Veil.pokebase: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

Swift Swim.text: When rainy, The Pokémon’s Speed doubles.
Swift Swim.serebii: When rainy, The Pokémon’s Speed doubles.
Swift Swim.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

Symbiosis.text: Passes the Pokémon's hold item to its adjacent ally when that ally consumes its hold item
Symbiosis.serebii: Passes the Pokémon's hold item to its adjacent ally when that ally consumes its hold item
Symbiosis.pokebase: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

Synchronize.text: When this Pokémon becomes Poisoned, Paralyzed, or Burned, so does the opponent. However, Fire-type and Water Veil ability Pokémon cannot be Burned, Poison-type and Steel-type and Immunity ability Pokémon cannot be Poisoned, and Limber ability Pokémon cannot be Paralyzed.
Synchronize.serebii: When this Pokémon becomes Poisoned, Paralyzed, or Burned, so does the opponent. However, Fire-type and Water Veil ability Pokémon cannot be Burned, Poison-type and Steel-type and Immunity ability Pokémon cannot be Poisoned, and Limber ability Pokémon cannot be Paralyzed.
Synchronize.pokebase: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

Tangled Feet.text: Pokémon’s evasion raises one level when Confused.
Tangled Feet.serebii: Pokémon’s evasion raises one level when Confused.
Tangled Feet.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

Technician.text: Moves with a base power of 60 or less are boosted in power by 50%
Technician.serebii: Moves with a base power of 60 or less are boosted in power by 50%
Technician.pokebase: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

Telepathy.text: Prevents damage from team-mates during Double battles
Telepathy.serebii: Prevents damage from team-mates during Double battles
Telepathy.pokebase: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

Thermal Exchange.text: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Fire-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by 1 stage. The Pokémon cannot be burned.
Thermal Exchange.serebii: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
Thermal Exchange.pokebase: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Fire-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by 1 stage. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

Thick Fat.text: Fire and Ice-type moves deal 50% damage.
Thick Fat.serebii: Fire and Ice-type moves deal 50% damage.
Thick Fat.pokebase: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

Torrent.text: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Water-type moves is increased by 50%.
Torrent.serebii: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Water-type moves is increased by 50%.
Torrent.pokebase: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

Tough Claws.text: Increases the power of moves that make physical contact by 30%
Tough Claws.serebii: Increases the power of moves that make physical contact by 30%
Tough Claws.pokebase: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

Toxic Debris.text: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Toxic Debris.serebii: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Toxic Debris.pokebase: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

Trace.text: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.
Trace.serebii: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.
Trace.pokebase: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.

Unaware.pokebase: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

Unburden.text: Speed is doubled once the held item is consumed.
Unburden.serebii: Speed is doubled once the held item is consumed.
Unburden.pokebase: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

Unnerve.text: The opponent Pokémon will never use their held Berry while the Pokémon is in battle.
Unnerve.serebii: The opponent Pokémon will never use their held Berry while the Pokémon is in battle.
Unnerve.pokebase: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

Unseen Fist.text: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected. This damage is reduced to 25%
Unseen Fist.serebii: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected. This damage is reduced to 25%
Unseen Fist.pokebase: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected.

Vital Spirit.text: The Pokémon cannot be Asleep while having this ability.
Vital Spirit.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be Asleep while having this ability.
Vital Spirit.pokebase: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

Volt Absorb.text: The Pokémon heals up to 1/4 of its maximum Hit Points when hit with Electric-type moves.
Volt Absorb.serebii: The Pokémon heals up to 1/4 of its maximum Hit Points when hit with Electric-type moves.
Volt Absorb.pokebase: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

Wandering Spirit.text: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Wandering Spirit.serebii: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Wandering Spirit.pokebase: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

Water Absorb.text: The Pokémon heals up to 1/4 of its maximum Hit Points when hit with Water-type moves.
Water Absorb.serebii: The Pokémon heals up to 1/4 of its maximum Hit Points when hit with Water-type moves.
Water Absorb.pokebase: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

Water Bubble.text: Decreases Fire-type move power on the Pokémon by 50%. Increases power of Water-type moves used by the Pokémon by 100% before adding STAB. Prevents Burn
Water Bubble.serebii: Decreases Fire-type move power on the Pokémon by 50%. Increases power of Water-type moves used by the Pokémon by 100% before adding STAB. Prevents Burn
Water Bubble.pokebase: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.

Weak Armor.text: When hit by an attack, the Pokémon's Defense is lowered by one stage but Speed is increased by two stages.
Weak Armor.serebii: When hit by an attack, the Pokémon's Defense is lowered by one stage but Speed is increased by two stages.
Weak Armor.pokebase: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

White Smoke.text: Opponents’ moves which lower this Pokémon’s stats have no effect. However this Pokémon may lower its own stats with its own moves.
White Smoke.serebii: Opponents’ moves which lower this Pokémon’s stats have no effect. However this Pokémon may lower its own stats with its own moves.
White Smoke.pokebase: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

Zero to Hero.text: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
Zero to Hero.serebii: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
Zero to Hero.pokebase: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
